"Act as a Senior Mobile Game Developer and AI Systems Architect.
Create a complete, functional prototype of a mobile-first 3D sandbox game (built with Three.js + Cannon-es for physics in a single responsive HTML/JS file ready for mobile browsers or Capacitor/Cordova wrapping).
1. Environment @COMMENT_BODY@ Mobile Controls:
The player spawns at the center of an infinite flat plane (with a clean minimalist grid texture for spatial awareness and movement feedback) under a bright sky.
Touch-first UI @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls:
Left side of the screen: A responsive virtual thumbstick for movement (walking/strafing).
Right side of the screen: Touch-and-drag area to rotate the camera/look around, paired with two large ergonomic action buttons: Jump and Use/Fire (which triggers the currently equipped item).
Ensure proper viewport meta tags (user-scalable=no, touch-action: none) so pinching or swiping doesn't accidentally scroll or zoom the mobile browser.
2. The Core Mechanic (The \"Text-to-Reality\" Prompt Bar):
Place a prominent, accessible \"✨ Create\" floating button at the top of the screen.
Tapping it pauses movement and opens a sleek text input overlay that automatically triggers the mobile virtual keyboard, complete with quick-tap suggestion chips (e.g., \"Airplane gun\", \"Bouncy trampoline\", \"Explosive rain\").
The player types any natural language prompt (e.g., \"a gun that shoots airplanes\", \"a giant car with square wheels\", \"make it rain exploding watermelons\").
Display a subtle non-blocking loading indicator (\"Materializing...\") while the AI processes the request.
3. AI Interpretation @COMMENT_BODY@ Procedural Execution (Generative Engine):
Connect the input to an LLM API call (provide an easy-to-find variable at the top of the code for my Gemini or OpenAI API_KEY, plus a small in-game settings gear icon on mobile so I can paste the key directly on my phone).
The internal System Prompt must instruct the LLM to return strictly structured JSON defining what to build using lightweight 3D primitives (combined boxes, spheres, cylinders, cones with colors and scales—optimized for mobile 60 FPS performance) and physics behaviors:
type: \"weapon\" (equipped in the player's hand), \"vehicle\" (drivable using the virtual joystick), \"physics_object\" (spawns in front of the player with mass/gravity), or \"world_event\" (alters gravity, sky color, or spawns weather/rain effects).
visuals: An array of combined 3D primitive shapes (e.g., a grey cylinder fuselage + two thin flat boxes for wings + a tail fin to represent an airplane).
action_behavior: Defines what happens when tapping the Use/Fire button (e.g., projectile: \"airplane\", speed: 50, gravityScale: 0.2, onImpact: \"explode\").
4. Offline / Fallback Mode (Crucial for Instant Mobile Testing):
If no API_KEY is entered, implement a local keyword parser with at least 5 pre-built behaviors (explicitly including \"gun that shoots airplanes\", \"explosion\", \"trampoline\", \"giant tower\", and \"low gravity\") so I can test the touch controls and physics immediately on my phone without setting up an API first.
Deliver the complete, well-commented, mobile-optimized code ready to run.
💡 Mobile Optimization Tips for Your Next Steps:
1. Performance Guardrails: Mobile GPUs heat up quickly when spawning infinite physics objects. Ask the AI to add an object pool / max entity limit (e.g., automatically despawning the oldest objects once there are more than 40 active physics bodies in the scene).
2. Voice-to-Text Input: Typing long prompts on a phone screen can slow down gameplay. You can easily ask the AI to add a microphone button next to the text bar using the browser's native Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition), letting players literally speak things into existence on mobile.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

  transform: rotate(18deg); animation: sheen 4.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes sheen{ 0%, 62%{ left: -40%; } 78%, 100%{ left: 130%; } }
#createBtn:active{ transform: scale(.95); filter: brightness(1.04); }
#createBtn .spark{ font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
#createBtn .kbd{ display: none; }
.icon-btn{
  pointer-events: auto; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 40px;
  display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--stroke); background: var(--glass);
  color: #fff; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 20, 40, .18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  transition: transform .15s ease, background .2s;
}
.icon-btn:active{ transform: scale(.9); background: rgba(20, 40, 64, .7); }
.icon-btn svg{ width: 19px; height: 19px; opacity: .92; }

/* ============================ STATUS PILLS ============================ */
#stats{
  position: fixed; left: calc(14px + var(--sal)); top: calc(58px + var(--sat)); z-index: 26;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; pointer-events: none;
  padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(8, 22, 38, .38); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  backdrop-filter: blur(9px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
  font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.86); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,20,40,.14);
}
#stats .dot{ width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--mint); }
#stats .sep{ opacity: .3; }
#stats b{ color: #fff; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .08em; }

#effectChip{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; top: calc(58px + var(--sat)); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px);
  z-index: 27; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(38, 24, 64, .82), rgba(18, 32, 58, .82));
  border: 1px solid rgba(180, 160, 255, .4);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(40, 20, 90, .28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #e9e1ff; transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
#effectChip.on{ opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
#effectChip .e-icon{ font-size: 12px; }
#effectChip .e-time{ padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); font-size: 8px; color: #fff; }

/* ============================ MATERIALIZING ============================ */
#materializing{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; top: calc(94px + var(--sat)); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px) scale(.96);
  z-index: 40; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 9px 15px 9px 11px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(12, 26, 44, .78); border: 1px solid rgba(160, 210, 255, .35);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(0, 22, 46, .3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #e8f5ff;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  transition: opacity .22s ease, transform .22s ease;
}
#materializing.on{ opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1); }
.spinner{
  width: 17px; height: 17px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-top-color: var(--gold);
  animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin{ to{ transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* ============================ TOASTS ============================ */
#toasts{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; top: calc(134px + var(--sat)); transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 45; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  width: min(92vw, 400px); pointer-events: none;
}
.toast{
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(9, 23, 40, .82); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0,20,40,.26); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 650; color: #f2f8ff; text-align: center;
  animation: toastIn .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) both;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.toast.out{ animation: toastOut .3s ease forwards; }
.toast .t-icon{ font-size: 13px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.toast.warn{ border-color: rgba(255, 190, 90, .4); background: rgba(54, 32, 10, .82); }
.toast.good{ border-color: rgba(110, 231, 200, .35); }
@keyframes toastIn{ from{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.96); } }
@keyframes toastOut{ to{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.97); } }

/* ============================ COACH HINT ============================ */
#hint{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; top: calc(134px + var(--sat)); transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 25; pointer-events: none;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .01em; color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 20, 40, .3);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0,20,40,.12);
  animation: hintFloat 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#hint.off{ opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); }
@keyframes hintFloat{ 0%,100%{ transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 50%{ transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-3px); } }

/* ============================ RETICLE ============================ */
#reticle{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 24px; height: 24px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%); z-index: 18; pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0; transition: opacity .25s ease;
}
#reticle.on{ opacity: .8; }
#reticle::before, #reticle::after{
  content:""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0, 20, 40, .45);
}
#reticle::before{ width: 2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); }
#reticle::after{
  width: 22px; height: 22px; background: transparent; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,20,40,.25), inset 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
#reticle.pulse::after{ animation: reticlePulse .22s ease-out; }
@keyframes reticlePulse{ 50%{ transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.35); border-color: #fff; } }

/* ============================ JOYSTICK ============================ */
#joystickZone{
  position: fixed; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 48%; height: 58%;
  z-index: 12; touch-action: none;
}
#joystick{
  position: fixed; width: 124px; height: 124px; border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%); pointer-events: none; z-index: 13;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.24), rgba(9, 24, 42, .18) 70%);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(0, 20, 40, .16), inset 0 0 34px rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  backdrop-filter: blur(7px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(7px);
  opacity: .72; transition: opacity .2s ease, width .15s ease, height .15s ease;
  will-change: left, top;
}
#joystick.active{ opacity: 1; }
#joystick .stick-ring{
  position: absolute; inset: 17px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}
#stickKnob{
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%); will-change: transform;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(210, 235, 255, .58) 60%, rgba(160, 200, 235, .4));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 24, 50, .26), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.9);
}
#joystick .stick-label{
  position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 9px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 6.5px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .22em; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}
#joystick .stick-tick{
  position: absolute; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.5); top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
}
#joystick .stick-tick.t{ top: 13px; } #joystick .stick-tick.b{ top: auto; bottom: 13px; }
#joystick .stick-tick.l{ left: 13px; } #joystick .stick-tick.r{ left: auto; right: 13px; }

/* ============================ LOOK AREA ============================ */
#lookZone{
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 8; touch-action: none;
  cursor: grab;
}
#lookZone:active{ cursor: grabbing; }

/* ============================ ACTION BUTTONS ============================ */
#actions{
  position: fixed; right: calc(18px + var(--sar)); bottom: calc(22px + var(--sab));
  z-index: 22; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.action{
  pointer-events: auto; position: relative; border: none; color: #fff;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
  border-radius: 50%; user-select: none; transition: transform .1s ease, filter .15s ease;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.action:active{ transform: scale(.92); filter: brightness(1.08); }
.action svg{ width: 28px; height: 28px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,20,40,.25)); }
.action .lbl{ font-size: 7.5px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .16em; opacity: .88; }
#jumpBtn{
  width: 66px; height: 66px; margin-right: 15px;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(255,255,255,.28), rgba(16, 34, 54, .42));
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 20, 40, .22), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
#jumpBtn svg{ width: 24px; height: 24px; }
#useBtn{
  width: 92px; height: 92px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 32% 24%, rgba(255,255,255,.42), transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #ff9a52 0%, #ff6a56 45%, #ff3f78 100%);
  border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(255, 70, 110, .38), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6), inset 0 -5px 14px rgba(140, 20, 50, .2);
}
#useBtn svg{ width: 34px; height: 34px; }
#useBtn .lbl{ font-size: 8.5px; letter-spacing: .18em; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(100,0,20,.3); }
#useBtn::before{
  content:""; position: absolute; inset: -6px; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
  background: conic-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.85) calc(var(--cd, 0) * 1turn), rgba(255,255,255,.13) 0);
  -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 4px), #000 calc(100% - 3px));
  mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 4px), #000 calc(100% - 3px));
  opacity: .85;
}
#useBtn.ready::before{ opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s .1s; }
#useBtn .badge{
  position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px; min-width: 19px; height: 19px; padding: 0 5px;
  border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(9, 23, 40, .85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  font-size: 8px; font-weight: 850; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}

/* ============================ ITEM CARD ============================ */
#itemCard{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(196px + var(--sab)); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
  z-index: 21; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 12px 7px 7px; border-radius: 15px;
  background: rgba(9, 23, 40, .62); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0,20,40,.22), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease; max-width: 78vw;
}
#itemCard.on{ opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
#itemCard .item-ico{
  width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: 0 0 32px; border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 209, 102, .3), rgba(255, 92, 122, .3));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
#itemCard .item-copy{ min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
#itemCard .item-name{ font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
#itemCard .item-action{ font-size: 7.5px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; }
#itemCard .item-type{ display: none; }

#vehicleHint{
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(270px + var(--sab)); transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 21; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
  padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(9,23,40,.72);
  border: 1px solid rgba(110,231,200,.4); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750;
  color: #d8fff5; transition: opacity .2s; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,20,40,.2);
}
#vehicleHint.on{ opacity: 1; }

/* ============================ OVERLAYS / SHEETS ============================ */
.overlay{
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(5, 14, 26, .42);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .25s ease;
}
.overlay.open{ opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.sheet{
  width: min(600px, 100%); max-height: calc(100% - 16px - var(--sat));
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20, 35, 53, .96), rgba(9, 18, 30, .98));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: 28px 28px 0 0;
  padding: 18px 17px calc(17px + var(--sab));
  box-shadow: 0 -24px 70px rgba(0, 8, 20, .5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  transform: translateY(36px); transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2, .85, .25, 1);
  overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; touch-action: pan-y;
}
.overlay.open .sheet{ transform: translateY(0); }
.sheet::before{
  content:""; display: block; width: 38px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); margin: -7px auto 13px;
}
.sheet-head{ display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 13px; }
.sheet-head .head-copy{ flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.eyebrow{ font-size: 8px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .22em; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; }
.sheet h2{ margin: 4px 0 3px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.025em; font-weight: 850; }
.sheet .sub{ margin: 0; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: rgba(232, 244, 255, .62); }
.close-btn{
  width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 34px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.close-btn svg{ width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.close-btn:active{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); transform: scale(.94); }

.chips{
  display: flex; gap: 7px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 2px 1px 11px;
  margin: 0 -2px; scrollbar-width: none; touch-action: pan-x;
}
.chips::-webkit-scrollbar{ display: none; }
.chip{
  flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); background: rgba(255,255,255,.065);
  color: rgba(240, 248, 255, .88); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 650;
  transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, transform .1s;
}
.chip:active{ transform: scale(.96); background: rgba(255, 209, 102, .16); border-color: rgba(255,209,102,.4); }
.chip .c-ico{ font-size: 12px; }

.inputRow{
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px; border-radius: 22px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
#promptInput{
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 48px; max-height: 128px; resize: none;
  padding: 12px 4px 10px; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent;
  color: #fff; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -.005em;
  touch-action: manipulation; overflow-y: auto;
}
#promptInput::placeholder{ color: rgba(220, 236, 255, .38); }
#promptInput:focus{ outline: none; }
.round-btn{
  flex: 0 0 auto; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: #fff; transition: transform .12s, background .15s;
}
.round-btn svg{ width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.round-btn:active{ transform: scale(.92); }
#micBtn.listening{
  background: rgba(255, 77, 109, .22); border-color: rgba(255, 120, 140, .55);
  animation: micPulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes micPulse{ 50%{ box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(255, 77, 109, .1); } }
#sendBtn{
  width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 17px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffd166, #ff8a4c 55%, #ff5c7a);
  color: #2c1508; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 100, 90, .3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);
  display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform .12s, filter .15s;
}
#sendBtn:active{ transform: scale(.94); }
#sendBtn svg{ width: 22px; height: 22px; }
#sendBtn:disabled{ filter: grayscale(.7) brightness(.7); }
.footnote{
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 11px 2px 0;
  font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; color: rgba(220, 236, 255, .42); font-weight: 550;
}
.footnote .dot{ width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); flex: 0 0 4px; }
#voiceStatus{
  margin: 8px 2px 0; font-size: 10px; color: var(--gold); display: none; font-weight: 650;
}
#voiceStatus.on{ display: block; animation: blink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes blink{ 50%{ opacity: .45; } }

/* ============================ SETTINGS ============================ */
#settingsOverlay{ align-items: center; padding: calc(14px + var(--sat)) 12px calc(14px + var(--sab)); }
#settingsOverlay .sheet{
  border-radius: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  max-height: min(86dvh, 760px); padding: 18px 17px 17px;
}
#settingsOverlay .sheet::before{ display: none; }
.field{ margin-bottom: 13px; }
.field > label{
  display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(220, 236, 255, .5);
}
.seg{ display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 13px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
.seg button{
  flex: 1; padding: 9px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: transparent;
  color: rgba(230, 242, 255, .6); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 750; transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.seg button.on{ background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .13); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.keyRow{ display: flex; gap: 7px; }
.keyRow input{ flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.settings-input, .settings-select{
  width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  color: #fff; font-size: 16px; outline: none;
}
.settings-input:focus, .settings-select:focus{ border-color: rgba(255, 190, 100, .6); background: rgba(255,255,255,.09); }
.settings-select{ appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; font-size: 13px; }
.settings-select option{ background: #142132; color: #fff; }
.eye-btn{
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750;
}
.help{ margin: 6px 1px 0; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: rgba(210, 230, 250, .4); }
.help a{ color: rgba(255, 209, 102, .8); text-decoration: none; }
.field-row{ display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.field-row > label{ margin: 0; }
.switch{
  width: 46px; height: 27px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); position: relative; transition: background .2s;
}
.switch::after{
  content:""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.75); transition: transform .2s, background .2s;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.switch.on{ background: rgba(110, 231, 200, .34); border-color: rgba(110,231,200,.45); }
.switch.on::after{ transform: translateX(19px); background: #d9fff7; }
.settings-actions{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; margin-top: 4px; }
.primary-btn{
  width: 100%; padding: 13px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);

## Objective
- Build a complete, mobile-first 3D sandbox game from a single responsive HTML/JS file using Three.js and cannon-es.
- Enable natural-language creations, touch controls, offline fallback behaviors, physics, vehicles, weapons, weather, and world effects.

## Requirements
- Mobile thumbstick movement and right-side drag camera/look controls.
- Large Jump and Use/Fire buttons with viewport pinch/scroll prevention.
- Floating “Create” prompt, suggestion chips, loading state, settings gear, optional microphone input.
- Gemini or OpenAI API key input, strict structured JSON generation, and local fallback when no key is present.
- Support weapon, vehicle, physics_object, and world_event creation types.
- Include gun that shoots airplanes, explosion, trampoline, giant tower, and low gravity fallbacks.
- Use lightweight primitives and cap physics entities at roughly 40 active bodies.

## Decisions
- Created a single-file application in `index.html`, with source assembled from modular files under `src/`.
- Used dynamic CDN imports for Three.js and cannon-es.
- Added in-memory settings persistence where browser storage is available.
- Added `API_KEY` and `API_PROVIDER` configuration variables near the top of the game script.
- Deferred projectile impact body removal until after `world.step()` to avoid cannon-es collision callback corruption.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the responsive glassy mobile HUD and settings/prompt overlays.
- Implemented stylized Three.js sky, grid ground, lighting, scenery, and first-person/third-person player.
- Implemented cannon-es player physics and infinite-ish flat plane.
- Implemented virtual thumbstick, camera dragging, jump, use/fire, keyboard, and touch controls.
- Implemented AI prompt calls and strict JSON normalization with Gemini/OpenAI support.
- Implemented at least gun, explosion, trampoline, tower, low gravity, and generic local creations.
- Implemented primitive visual assembly, pooled entities, weapons, projectiles, impacts, explosions, rain, vehicles, and 40-body recycling.
- Added speech-recognition UI support.
- Started a local server and ran desktop/mobile browser captures.
- Verified prompt, equipped weapon, firing, trampoline, vehicle, rain, and body-limit UI flows in browser tests.
- Extracted and syntax-checked the module script successfully.

### Active
- Collision-impact fix is patched but should receive final retest and verification.
- Visual tuning for washed-out scene colors and HUD overlap was noted but not confirmed complete.

### Blocked
- Browser test logs need to be revisited for the exact runtime errors found during the “test-game” run.
- The latest build may not include all source edits if `index.html` was not rebuilt after the last patches.

## Next Move
1. Rebuild `index.html` by combining `src/01-boot.js` through `src/07-loop.js` with the HTML shell.
2. Verify the final collision fix is present in `index.html`, especially `pendingImpacts`, `resolveProjectileImpacts`, and post-step resolution.
3. Run syntax checking and a fresh mobile browser test covering firing, explosions, vehicles, low gravity, and 40-body recycling.
4. Tune grid/sky contrast and inspect mobile HUD for overlap at narrow portrait sizes.
5. Confirm the local server responds from `http://localhost:3000` and the loading overlay reaches `window.__READY__ === true`.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Final single-file game output.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/01-boot.js`: API/config constants and shared runtime state.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/02-ai.js`: System prompt, API calls, JSON normalization, and local fallback parser.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/03-engine.js`: Three.js/cannon-es renderer, player, world, sky, ground, and scenery.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/04-entities.js`: Primitive entities, pool, vehicles, impacts, explosions, weather, and recycling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/05-player.js`: Player movement, vehicle interaction, and action handling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/06-ui.js`: Touch controls, prompt/settings overlays, voice input, and HUD.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/07-loop.js`: Main frame loop and startup/diagnostics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/shell.html`: HTML/CSS shell used to assemble the single-file build.

## Important Context
- The likely collision fix identifiers are `pendingImpacts`, `resolveProjectileImpacts`, and `resolveProjectileImpact`.
- The 40-body guardrail is implemented through the pooled entity system and oldest-entity despawning.
- Browser screenshots were saved under `/tmp/opencode`, but do not assume they were the latest or fully read.
- A server test session named `forge` may still be running at port `3000`.
- Final visual tuning and post-fix retesting remain outstanding.

## What's in it

**World & controls**
- Infinite flat plane with a subtle 1 m grid, low-poly hills, rocks, grass, clouds, and a landing pad.
- Left virtual thumbstick (dynamic, snaps to where you touch), right-side drag-to-look, large Jump and Use/Fire buttons.

**Gameplay systems**
- Equip/fire weapons, projectiles with explode/bounce/stick impacts, explosions, rain/weather, sky/gravity effects.
- Drivable vehicles with auto-mount, boost, exit, and size-aware chase camera.
- 40-body hard cap with object pooling and oldest-entity recycling.
